items.title: Godot Showreel 2026
items.en_oneliner: Godot's 2026 showreel is out, with a record 422 community submissions and gameplay from featured projects including Slay the Spire 2.

items.title: Rockstar has finally posted GTA 6's full map online—thank goodness, because clearing the entire thing in game takes ages
items.en_title: Rockstar has finally posted GTA 6's full map online—thank goodness, because clearing the entire thing in game takes ages
items.en_oneliner: Rockstar has published the full map of Leonida, a huge fog-of-war region, as a handy reference while players clear it in game.

items.title: Making a sledding game feel like sledding: one engine, three physics configs
items.en_title: Making a sledding game feel like sledding: one engine, three physics configs
items.en_oneliner: The author shares how six numbers per mode shape the feel of browser sledding game SledRun, with track width and gravity doing most of the work.

items.title: Ubisoft lay off 166 more staff, this time at their Montreal and Quebec City studios, while mumbling about "current production priorities and business needs"
items.en_title: Ubisoft lay off 166 more staff, this time at their Montreal and Quebec City studios, while mumbling about "current production priorities and business needs"
items.en_oneliner: Ubisoft is cutting 166 more developers at its Montreal and Quebec City studios, both of which worked on Assassin's Creed Shadows, as big-studio layoffs keep coming.

items.title: A new Fallout game has been rated in Australia, and it's a hidden object game
items.en_title: A new Fallout game has been rated in Australia, and it's a hidden object game
items.en_oneliner: A new Fallout title called A Wasteland Full of Cats has been rated in Australia — and it turns out to be a hidden object game.

items.title: Blender Artist Breaks Down Spider-Verse-Style Hand-Painted Effect
items.en_title: Blender Artist Breaks Down Spider-Verse-Style Hand-Painted Effect
items.en_oneliner: The artist breaks down an "exploding layers" technique for recreating Spider-Verse-style hand-painted looks in Blender.

items.title: Parse an osu! skin.ini with Python and check that every referenced prefix still has files
items.en_title: Parse an osu! skin.ini with Python and check that every referenced prefix still has files
items.en_oneliner: A stdlib-only Python script that parses skin.ini and checks whether every referenced prefix and image file is actually present, so a skin never silently falls back to the default.
